ratici_shared: Somethin' I can do for you? Ask quick — I talk faster'n I listen, as it were.
You'll pardon the hat stayin' on. Consider it a heretofore act of civic kindness.
Wilovan does the philosophizin'. I do the notin' of exits. You came in by the only one, incidentally.
We don't steal. We recover. My associate's phrasin', that. Mine ran less charitable.

floor_layers._pick: #225 first floor layer (was biome-default inn plank, zero floor_layers): the Brothers' parlor reads as a richer parquet than the plain inn plank -- a classy gentleman-thieves' establishment. Library pack warm reddish parquet ([21,3]/[22,3]/[21,4]/[23,4], rgb~135,86,50), already manifest-wired (bundle:true). Chosen over castle brown [6,18], which windowed-read too close to the inn plank to differentiate. Rugs (rug_woven_cream/rug_woven_red) still dress it on top; footstep-wood stays honest. (Shares the guild's parquet: both are finer establishments in different cities -- an acceptable, thematic overlap.)

entities._comment: talk_pool stays the pool-then-conversation precedent's first-talk-of-a-waking flavor (interact()'s npc branch), `conversation` carries every later talk into the real graph.
entities.observe: A Gnoll in a tailored vest, tall hat on indoors, both hands in view on the table. He looked at the door behind you before your face.
entities.friendly_line: He inclines the hat half an inch — a genuine courtesy, not a performance of one. "A pleasure," he says.
talk_pool: Evening. Might I say, {addr}, you carry yourself like a person things happen to. We collect a few of those.
Manners cost nothing and buy everything, in my experience. Mind the rug — Normen fusses over it more than he'll admit.
You'll notice the hat stays on. Best we keep it that way, between friends.
We don't steal, whatever you've heard. We recover. A finer distinction than it sounds, and the foundation of our business.

lines: The Rest sends its regards, {addr}, which from that house is a standing ovation.
A quiet evening, well kept. There's no higher compliment in my line and no lower fee.

dialogue.speaker: Wilovan
dialogue.text: Evening, {addr}. Fine weather for good behavior.

entities.sleep_toast: Even the couch here fits like it was fitted for you. You sleep through to morning without waking once.

entities._comment: Bespoke short-Drake rig replaces the flagged pc_drake_m+tint placeholder. Voice/profile contract: docs/design/character-profiles.md Ratici section (fast, dropped g's, fancy-word overreach, menace opens polite; [Gentleman Thief] 7.24 is the class-name ceiling, [Aerial Dodge] is Vol-8 and BANNED).
entities.observe: A short Drake in careful browns, floppy cap settled down over the neck-spines. His eyes did your full inventory the moment you stepped in, and he's too polite to say what it came to.
entities.friendly_line: A person of discernment, Wilovan said. I withdraw one full half of my suspicions.

lines: Boulevard's where the operation runs, friend. Start where the money's loudest.

talk_pool_stages._comment: Marker-holders get the warmer register (fence-tier trust, same gate as Wilovan's fence).
lines: Marker-holder. Sit where you like, then — the good stool's the one that doesn't wobble.
Word went round about the Coyle business. Tidy work. Rougher'n I'd have done it, or gentler. One of the two.

entities.observe: A broad man dealing solitaire with a bowler still on his head, squaring each card to the one under it before he sets down the next.
talk_pool: Evenin'. The cards are friendly here. The stakes, somewhat less so.
House rule: hats stay on. You'll know the exception when you see it, and you'll want to be elsewhere for it.

entities.observe: A Gnoll on his feet beside the door, a folded coat over one arm — a coat cut for a smaller man.
talk_pool: The cots? For gentlemen between engagements. Which is all of us, officially.
Mind the rug. A fellow scuffed it once. The apology took longer than the mending.

entities.observe: A Drake on a stool, back to the wall, the good shelf and the banded chest in front of him. Look at the chest and he is already looking at you.
talk_pool: The shelf's spoken for, friend. Marker-holders and upward.

entities.observe: A drink counter kept cleaner than the law would ever ask it to be.
Rings from a hundred glasses, sanded out and earned back.
Two rows of bottles, the bottom row opened, the corks shoved back in crooked. The top row's wax is unbroken over every neck.
A keg with a tapped face and an honest week's dents.
Its brother. Slightly fuller, slightly further from the door.

entities._comment: Card table cluster: table_brown reuse (the existing (6,5) table is Wilovan's SITTING table; this one is the game). Stools flank.
entities.observe: Coppers, a dog-eared deck, and chalk tallies in three different handwritings. A hand reaches past you and adds a chalk stroke to the middle column.
One leg is a finger short of the other three, with a folded playing card wedged under it; the stool still rocks when you touch it.
The good stool. You'd have to earn it.

entities._comment: Fence-adjacent stash dressing: interact is gated DIEGETICALLY (locked line) on brothers_marker, mirroring Wilovan's fence gate — no mechanics beyond flavor + the existing fence node carrying actual stock.
entities.observe: Banded oak, twice-locked, sitting where the quiet gentleman can count who looks at it.
entities.toast: Locked twice over. The quiet gentleman clears his throat, courteously.

entities.observe: The ledgers have no titles and the boxes have no labels, and the third box along still carries a shipping tag with the writing inked out.
Blanket drawn flat, corners folded square; the pillow at the head end has no dent.
Less neat. A paperback under the pillow, spine broken at the same chapter.

entities._comment: Bespoke hat-stand sprite replaces the flagged crate placeholder; preserves the Brothers' hats-off tell.
entities.observe: Hats on pegs, every one accounted for. House rule says hats stay on, and these came off anyway.

entities._comment: v0.15 T4.4 regional repeatable work, 2 of 3 (the serving_tray idiom: once_per_waking + gold, banked under interactions.gd's `serve:` key). NEW COUNTER invrisil_errands_run, frozen at the next tag. Ungated so the affordance is reachable the first time a player finds the parlor; the marker-holder `variants` arm is the earned RATE, not an entry fee. Cell (5,1) sits between the cots and the counter, off every route the six parlor-touching canonicals walk.
entities.observe: A slate by the cots, chalked in two hands: addresses with no names against them, times with no dates, and a column of initials down the edge. Small work, and two of the initials repeat all the way down.
entities.once_per_waking_toast: The slate is wiped clean. Come back when the chalk's been busy.
entities.toast: You take the top line off the slate and walk it across Invrisil, no questions asked at either end. Two gold in your hand, and behind you a wet cloth is already going over the line.

variants.toast: The line you take off the slate runs longer this time, out to a door further out of the way. With the marker the walk pays three gold, without it two.
